摘要Abstract

我们介绍We introducePAC零PACZero，一系列 PAC 私有零阶机制，用于微调大型语言模型，在以下位置提供可用实用程序, a family of PAC-private zeroth-order mechanisms for fine-tuning large language models that delivers usable utility atI​(S∗;Y1:T)=0I(S^{*};Y_{1:T})\!=\!0。这种隐私制度限制了先前的成员推理攻击（MIA）后验成功率，DP 框架仅在以下情况下匹配 MIA 抵抗级别：. This privacy regime bounds the membership-inference attack (MIA) posterior success rate at the prior, an MIA-resistance level the DP framework matches only atε=0\varepsilon\!=\!0和无限的噪音。下面的所有 DP-ZO 比较均在 MIA 后验水平上进行匹配。关键的见解是，PAC Privacy 仅在发布取决于哪个候选子集是秘密时才对相互信息收费。符号量化子集聚合的零阶梯度会产生频繁的and infinite noise. All DP-ZO comparisons below are matched at the MIA posterior level. The key insight is that PAC Privacy charges mutual information only when the release depends on which candidate subset is the secret. Sign-quantizing subset-aggregated zeroth-order gradients creates frequent一致unanimity，每个候选子集就更新方向达成一致的步骤；在这些步骤中，释放的符号的条件互信息成本为零。我们提出了两种跨越隐私与实用性权衡的变体：, steps at which every candidate subset agrees on the update direction; at these steps the released sign costs zero conditional mutual information. We propose two variants that span the privacy-utility trade-off:PACZero-MI（通过对二进制版本进行精确校准来预算 MI）以及(budgeted MI via exact calibration on the binary release) andPACZero-ZPL (I=0I\!=\!0通过在分歧步骤上进行统一的硬币翻转）。我们在 LoRA 和全参数轨道上使用 OPT-1.3B 和 OPT-6.7B 评估 SST-2 和 SQuAD。对 SST-2 OPT-1.3B 进行全面微调via a uniform coin flip on disagreement steps). We evaluate on SST-2 and SQuAD with OPT-1.3B and OPT-6.7B in both LoRA and full-parameter tracks. On SST-2 OPT-1.3B full fine-tuning atI=0I\!=\!0, PACZero-ZPL达到reaches88.99±0.91%\bm{88.99\!\pm\!0.91\%}，内, within2.12.1非私有 MeZO 基线的 pp (pp of the non-private MeZO baseline (91.191.1英国金融时报）。现有方法在高隐私制度下无法产生可用的效用FT). No prior method produces usable utility in the high-privacy regimeε<1\varepsilon\!<\!1, 和, andPACZero-ZPL在 OPT-1.3B 和 OPT-6.7B 上获得具有竞争力的 SST-2 精度和非平凡的 SQuAD F1obtains competitive SST-2 accuracy and nontrivial SQuAD F1 across OPT-1.3B and OPT-6.7B atI=0I\!=\!0.

1 简介Introduction

零阶 (ZO) 优化已成为一阶 LLM 微调的内存可处理替代方案，用每步两次前向传递取代反向传播Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a memory-tractable alternative to first-order LLM fine-tuning, replacing backpropagation with two forward passes per step[24]。当训练语料库敏感时，已知训练过的权重会通过成员推理攻击 (MIA) 和逐字提取泄露个人记录. When the training corpus is sensitive, trained weights are known to leak individual records through membership inference attacks (MIA) and verbatim extraction[33, 11, 12, 27, 25]。主要的防御是差分隐私（DP），它是一种定量保证，可以证明任何单个训练记录对发布模型的影响都是有界的，并由参数参数化. The dominant defense is differential privacy (DP), a quantitative guarantee that the influence of any single training record on the released model is provably bounded, parameterized by a parameterε\varepsilon。主力实例化，DP-SGD. The workhorse instantiation, DP-SGD[1]，将每条记录的梯度剪辑为固定的灵敏度预算，并添加通过 Rényi accountant 跨步骤跟踪的高斯噪声, clips per-record gradients to a fixed sensitivity budget and adds Gaussian noise tracked across steps via the Rényi accountant[26, 18]。这种方法扩展到 LLM 微调. This methodology extends to LLM fine-tuning[45, 23]现已使用成熟的生产工具with mature production tooling now in use[43, 4, 30]。将其插入 ZO 产生 DP-ZO. Plugging it into ZO yields DP-ZO[46, 36, 5]，它对每步零阶标量而不是完整梯度进行剪辑和噪声处理。由于标量是一维的并且扰动方向与数据无关，因此 DP-ZO 消除了每步噪声中的显式维度依赖性。然而，它并没有消除对效用的影响。每个已发布的 DP-ZO 方法都继承了 DP 严格的实用程序与隐私权衡：可用的准确性需要宽松的隐私预算，而实用程序会崩溃, which clips and noises the per-step zeroth-order scalar instead of the full gradient. Because the scalar is one-dimensional and the perturbation direction is data-independent, DP-ZO removes the explicit dimension dependence from the per-step noise. It does not, however, remove the impact on utility. Every published DP-ZO method inherits DP’s harsh utility-privacy trade-off: usable accuracy requires a loose privacy budget, and utility collapses asε\varepsilon收紧，因为底层机制（最坏情况下每条记录的敏感度依次组成）tightens, because the underlying mechanism (worst-case per-record sensitivity composed sequentially overTT步骤）不变。这种权衡是 DP-SGD 在迭代深度学习训练中长期观察到的属性，其中紧密steps) is unchanged. This trade-off is a long-observed property of DP-SGD in iterative deep-learning training, where tightε\varepsilon产生急剧的效用损失和不同的影响效果produces steep utility loss and disparate-impact effects[2, 38, 14, 13, 21, 8, 32];因此，在法学硕士微调中达到有意义的高隐私制度需要一种根本不同的隐私会计机制。; reaching a meaningful high-privacy regime in LLM fine-tuning therefore requires a fundamentally different privacy accounting mechanism.

政治行动委员会隐私PAC Privacy[40]用基于发布的经验协方差的噪声校准代替 DP 的最坏情况敏感性，并限制秘密和发布之间的互信息 (MI)。 PAC 隐私的主要优势在于它利用了固有的replaces DP’s worst-case sensitivity with a noise calibration based on the empirical covariance of the release, and bounds the mutual information (MI) between the secret and the release. The key advantage of PAC Privacy is that it exploits the inherent稳定性stability输出并校准最小噪声以实现稳定输出。最近的工作将框架扩展到推理时间上的自适应组合of the output and calibrates minimal noise for stable outputs. Recent work extends the framework to adaptive composition over inference-time反应response溪流streams[49]。与私人相关的案件仍然悬而未决. What remains open is the case relevant to private迭代的iterative微调，与 DP-SGD 运行的设置相同，在每个优化步骤中向对手发布每步更新。在法学硕士规模（fine-tuning, the same setting in which DP-SGD operates, where a per-step update is released to the adversary at every optimization step. At LLM scale (d∼109d\!\sim\!10^{9}, T∼103T\!\sim\!10^{3}），然而，在这个维度上实现从输出协方差导出的基于实例的最佳噪声校准成本高昂，使得迭代训练超出了规范 PAC 算法的范围。), however, optimal instance-based noise calibration derived from the output covariance is prohibitively expensive to achieve at this dimensionality, leaving iterative training out of reach of canonical PAC algorithms.

5 相关作品Related Works

DP-SGD [1]将每条记录的梯度剪裁到敏感度预算，并添加由 Rényi 会计跟踪的高斯噪声clips per-record gradients to a sensitivity budget and adds Gaussian noise tracked by Rényi accounting[26, 18]。成熟的产品线使该模板适应 LLM 微调，并对裁剪和适配器集成进行了改进. A mature line adapts this template to LLM fine-tuning, with refinements to clipping and adapter integration[45, 20, 16, 10, 9, 48, 23]。零阶分支将每步有限差分标量而不是全梯度私有化，并消除了每步噪声的显式维度依赖性。. The zeroth-order branch privatizes the per-step finite-difference scalar instead of the full gradient and removes explicit dimension dependence from the per-step noise.Zhang et al. [46](DPZero) 用高斯标量机制 DP-ZO 证明了几乎与维度无关的速率(DPZero) prove nearly dimension-independent rates with a Gaussian scalar mechanism, the DP-ZO[36]采用与高斯和拉普拉斯机制相同的标量私有化经验（后者使纯adopts the same scalar-privatization insight empirically with Gaussian and Laplace mechanisms (the latter enabling pureε\varepsilon-DP），以及-DP), andBao et al. [5](DP-AggZO) 聚合体(DP-AggZO) aggregateKK在裁剪之前将有限差分系数转换为向量，报告 OPT-1.3B/6.7B 上 DP-ZO 基线中最强的结果。所有这些都继承了每个记录（或每个聚合）的敏感度界限、按比例缩放的附加噪声以及顺序组合finite-difference coefficients into a vector before clipping, reporting the strongest results among the DP-ZO baselines on OPT-1.3B/6.7B. All of these inherit a per-record (or per-aggregate) sensitivity bound, additive noise scaled to it, and sequential composition overTT步骤，这是有据可查的实用程序崩溃的根源steps, which is the source of the well-documented utility collapse asε→0\varepsilon\!\to\!0 [2, 14, 13]. PAC零PACZero取消每条记录的敏感度：子集聚合的符号量化使每步释放一个比特，通过噪声二进制释放的精确互信息而不是削波范数进行校准，每样本削波仅保留作为效用稳定器。的retires per-record sensitivity: subset-aggregated sign quantization makes the per-step release a single bit, calibrated by the exact mutual information of the noised binary release rather than by a clipping norm, with per-sample clipping retained only as a utility stabilizer. ThePACZero-ZPL变体在达成分歧的步骤上发布与数据无关的代币variant releases data-independent coins on disagreement steps to reachI=0I\!=\!0，一个政权，其匹配的 MIA DP 等价（, a regime whose matched-MIA DP equivalent (ε=0\varepsilon\!=\!0）在任何高斯或拉普拉斯 DP-ZO 会计下都需要无界的每步噪声。单位版本与 signSGD 共享结构) would require unbounded per-step noise under any Gaussian or Laplace DP-ZO accountant. 6 讨论和限制Discussion and Limitations

隐私语义：PAC 隐私与 DP。Privacy semantics: PAC Privacy vs DP.PAC Privacy 和 DP 回答不同的问题，我们不主张等同（§PAC Privacy and DP answer different questions and we do not claim equivalence (§2）。 DP 限制了相邻数据集上输出分布之间的最坏情况对数似然比； PAC 隐私限制了输出与从指定分布中提取的秘密之间的相互信息。核心的实际区别是). DP bounds the worst-case log-likelihood ratio between output distributions on neighboring datasets; PAC Privacy bounds the mutual information between the output and the secret drawn from a specified distribution. The core practical distinction is噪声被校准到什么程度what noise is calibrated to：DP 校准到最坏情况下每条记录的敏感度，而 PAC Privacy 校准到数据生成分布下输出的经验稳定性: DP calibrates to worst-case per-record sensitivity, while PAC Privacy calibrates to the empirical stability of the output under the data-generating distribution𝒟\mathcal{D}。在符号量化和子集聚合之后，这种稳定性可能比灵敏度小得多，并且在一致步骤上它恰好为零，从而允许定向更新而无需隐私成本。. After sign quantization and subset aggregation, this stability can be much smaller than sensitivity—and on unanimity steps it is exactly zero, allowing directed updates at no privacy cost.

我们的建设Our construction𝒟=Unif​{S1,…,SM}\mathcal{D}=\mathrm{Unif}\{S_{1},\ldots,S_{M}\}具有平衡的会员资格直接模拟标准 MIA 游戏with balanced membership directly models the standard MIA game[33, 42]：对所有候选者进行二次采样，了解所有候选者的对手确定是否包含目标记录。特别是，: a universe of candidates is subsampled, and the adversary who knows all candidates determines whether a target record was included. In particular,PACZero-ZPL’s I​(S∗;Y1:T)=0I(S^{*};Y_{1:T})\!=\!0是我们显式候选集分布下的保证is a guarantee under our explicit candidate-set distribution𝒟=Unif​{S1,…,SM}\mathcal{D}\!=\!\mathrm{Unif}\{S_{1},\ldots,S_{M}\}，不是最坏情况邻接 DP 保证，并且匹配的 MIA 优先 DP-, not a worst-case-adjacency DP guarantee, and the matched-MIA-prior DP-ε\varepsilon我们表格中的注释（例如，“DPannotations in our tables (e.g., “DPε=2\varepsilon\!=\!2”）是校准到相同的后部 MIA 下的数值参考”) are numerical references calibrated to the same posterior MIA bound under𝒟\mathcal{D}，不将 DP 语义传输到, not transfers of DP semantics toPAC零PACZero。我们还注意到，虽然我们专注于抵抗平衡 MIA 博弈，但 PAC Privacy 为秘密数据集的任何推理攻击提供了具体保障，例如重建、群组 MIA 和主动识别. We also note that while we have focused on resistance against balanced MIA games, PAC Privacy provides concrete guarantees for any inference attack on the secret dataset, such as reconstruction, group MIA, and positive identification[41].

平滑灵敏度等多项 DP 放松Several DP relaxations such as smooth sensitivity[29], 每个实例 DP, per-instance DP[39]、个人隐私核算, individual privacy accounting[15, 44], 河豚, Pufferfish[19]，和贝叶斯DP, and Bayesian DP[37]还可以通过合并特定于实例的信息或分布信息来将噪声降低到全局敏感度最坏情况以下。然而，所有这些都保持校准到某种形式的每记录差异（局部敏感度、每个实例reduce noise below the global-sensitivity worst case also by incorporating instance-specific or distributional information. However, all remain calibrated to some form of per-record divergence (local sensitivity, per-instanceεi\varepsilon_{i}，或成对判别分布），因此每当任何单个记录的包含改变输出分布时，它们都会收取正成本。 PAC Privacy 的分布式 MI 公式避免了这种情况：它询问输出是否有助于识别哪些, or pairwise discriminative distributions), so they charge a positive cost whenever any single record’s inclusion changes the output distribution. PAC Privacy’s distributional MI formulation avoids this: it asks whether the output helps identify which子集subset是否处于活动状态，而不是是否区分特定记录对。当答案集体为“否”（一致同意）时，即使单个记录的成对敏感性为正，成本也为零。这种结构差异使得有用信号能够在is active, not whether it distinguishes specific record pairs. When the answer is collectively “no” (unanimity), the cost is zero even if individual records’ pairwise sensitivities are positive. This structural difference is what enables useful signal atMI=0\mathrm{MI}\!=\!0.

7 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introducedPAC零PACZero，一系列 PAC 私有零阶机制，用于微调大型语言模型，围绕单个原语构建：符号量化子集聚合 ZO 更新并释放一位标识秘密子集符号的位。二进制版本允许精确的互信息校准作为一维高斯积分，取代了规范 PAC 算法使用的基于方差的上限。它还暴露了后验加权一致性，这使得条件 MI 为零, a family of PAC-private zeroth-order mechanisms for fine-tuning large language models, built around a single primitive: sign-quantize subset-aggregated ZO updates and release one bit identifying the sign of the secret subset. The binary release admits exact mutual-information calibration as a one-dimensional Gaussian integral, replacing the variance-based upper bound used by canonical PAC algorithms. It also exposes posterior-weighted unanimity, which contributes zero conditional MI on∼34{\sim}34–45%45\%SST-2 训练步骤。相同的原语实例化了跨越隐私-实用边界的两个变体：of SST-2 training steps. The same primitive instantiates two variants that span the privacy-utility frontier:PACZero-MI（预算 MI）和(budgeted MI) andPACZero-ZPL (I​(S∗;Y1:T)=0I(S^{*};Y_{1:T})\!=\!0通过统一发布分歧步骤）。对SST-2 OPT-1.3B进行全面微调，via a uniform release on disagreement steps). [5]。在校准噪声之前进行量化会打开 MIA 电阻级别，. 硬件。Hardware.

所有实验都作为单 GPU 作业运行（每个 GPU 一个进程）。 OPT-1.3B 单元混合使用 NVIDIA A4000 (16 GB)、A5000 (24 GB)、A6000 (48 GB)、A100 (40 GB) 和 H100 (80 GB)；出于内存原因，OPT-6.7B 单元仅使用 A100 (40 GB) 和 H100 (80 GB)。All experiments run as single-GPU jobs (one process per GPU). OPT-1.3B cells use a mix of NVIDIA A4000 (16 GB), A5000 (24 GB), A6000 (48 GB), A100 (40 GB), and H100 (80 GB); OPT-6.7B cells use exclusively A100 (40 GB) and H100 (80 GB) for memory reasons.
